content:
State: closed

## Summary
Centralize the ATC monetary policy in the ecosystem monorepo.

### Canonical consensus
- 360,000,000 ATC max supply
- 360-second target block time
- 360,000-block halving interval
- 36 halving epochs
- 500 ATC initial subsidy
- block-height-only issuance trigger
- final emission block 12,959,999

### Integrated components
- `components/atc-algorithm/src/economics.rs` — canonical issuance implementation
- `components/atc-algorithm/docs/ATC-MONETARY-POLICY-001.md` — specification
- `components/atc-mining/src/reward.rs` — canonical reward consumption
- `components/atc-mining/Cargo.toml` — path dependency on canonical algorithm
- `components/a-townchain/consensus/monetary_policy_binding.rs` — orchestration binding
- root `Cargo.toml` — algorithm + mining workspace members

This makes `a-townchain-ecosystem` the integration SSOT for the three components while preserving component boundaries.
